item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently declares a national emergency and invokes statutory Ready Reserve authority, making that authority immediately available to specified military officials according to its terms.","evidence":"hereby declare that a national emergency exists at the southern border of the United States"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory determination that the emergency requires the Armed Forces and invokes section 2808 construction authority; the legal consequence occurs in the proclamation itself.","evidence":"the construction authority provided in section 2808 of title 10, United States Code, is invoked and made available"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the relevant military secretaries to decide, within their discretion and applicable law, how many Ready Reserve personnel should be activated to support border activities; the segment does not dictate a particular activation result.","evidence":"as the Secretary concerned, in the Secretary's discretion, determines to be appropriate"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The named secretaries must take appropriate implementing actions, but whether and how to act—including any jurisdictional transfer—remains conditional and discretionary; the accompanying disclaimer creates no enforceable right or benefit.","evidence":"shall take all appropriate actions, consistent with applicable law, to use or support the use of the authorities herein invoked"}]}
